items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: You know who was running behind me for that clarinet? Willie Humphrey.

ctx.x: I used to play opera and everything. You see the clarinet I told you I saw before this, that pentamon? You know who was running behind me for that clarinet? Willie Humphrey. Right now playing in the glass. He was running me down for that clarinet. Man, I had another one. I had another one before that. I lined it all with diamonds, you know? Yeah, them artificial diamonds.
